label: R20-ARITH-ROUTE-CLOSURE
title: Remove the unreachable non-half generic binary_pre_parts route
forbidden_regions: half-lane path, interfaces, latency tables and shared test entrypoints
scope: Prove the supported non-half operation routes are exhaustive, replace the unreachable IT_ARITH generic binary_pre_parts fallback with a deterministic non-computational default, and add focused route/illegal-default checks without changing supported-operation latency.
validation: Lane runs only diff-check and lightweight static/elaboration checks; merged candidate owns all heavy simulation. Test must cover ADD/SUB, MUL/FMA, SCVTF/UCVTF route selection, half-path preservation, reset/kill/pause and default behavior.
acceptance: No supported op reaches the generic fallback; ap_pre->pp_pre binary_pre_parts combinational call is absent from the non-half default; no state/interface/latency change.
resource: No local or GamePC heavy job; do not acquire a lock for pure editing/static inspection.
